title: sim/scenario.py chaos wiring broken: sim.chaos does not exist and LossRule missing required node_id
description: Spotted during mypy-gate worker6-1nfe. src/lichen/sim/scenario.py _apply_chaos (lines 340-353): (1) calls self.sim.chaos.add_rule(rule) at :347 and :352, but Simulation (lichen/sim/simulation/base.py:342) only exposes property chaos_engine / _chaos_engine -> AttributeError whenever a scenario has a chaos event; (2) LossRule(loss_probability=params.get("rate",0.1)) at :346 omits required dataclass field node_id: str (lora_medium/chaos.py:241, package ships py.typed) -> TypeError; (3) code never guards chaos_engine is None before adding rules. Both loss and partition branches are dead-on-arrival at runtime.
